verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents a REST API with OAuth 2.0 and personal access token auth, a 'meetings API' reference page, and webhooks, so programmatic access for an agent exists in principle. Nothing in the evidence shows endpoints for checking availability, creating bookings, rescheduling, or cancelling, and there is no MCP server. Probes also found no llms.txt and no public OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: documented availability-query, booking, reschedule and cancel endpoints; an official MCP server; a machine-readable OpenAPI spec; hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent flow.
